title: UKSSSC Assistant Accountant Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Assistant Accountant posts under UKSSSC / Uttarakhand government departments
qualification: B.Com / equivalent commerce qualification as per UKSSSC advertisement
ageLimit: As per UKSSSC Assistant Accountant notification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://sssc.uk.gov.in
2. Open Assistant Accountant apply online
3. Register and fill form
4. Upload documents and pay fee
5. Submit before last date
shortDescription: UKSSSC Assistant Accountant Online Form 2026 – apply at sssc.uk.gov.in for Uttarakhand Assistant Accountant posts.
content:
Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has invited online applications for Assistant Accountant posts.

Commerce graduates should apply on sssc.uk.gov.in, complete fee payment, and prepare for the written examination as per the official syllabus.
